title: Wrong Plates
summary: Recover the marked vehicle from Canal Loading Bay. Confirm the pickup, lose the police and deliver that exact car to my garage. A replacement will not pay.

pickup.text: Stop the taxi in {place}'s bay and press K to confirm the pickup.

escape.text: Lose the police. Break line of sight and stay hidden.

deliver.text: Deliver that taxi to {place} ({distance} m). Stop in the bay and press K.
